decision_changed: which two session-clock intervals are eligible for P4 preparation

selection_rule.nominal_duration: 300 C4 chunks; approximately 300.001640176334 seconds at the exact sampling rate
selection_rule.candidate_starts: every 30000-sample session-grid start whose complete 9000000-sample half-open interval lies inside its frozen parent window
selection_rule.field_rounding: float64 sign(x)*floor(abs(x)/40+0.5)*40; expected hash must match
selection_rule.nearest_field_support: each knot owns the half-open session-sample Voronoi interval between adjacent time-knot midpoints; outer knots extend to recording bounds
selection_rule.primary: maximum count of rounded-state changes whose nearest-field boundary sample lies in the candidate half-open interval
selection_rule.secondary: maximum number of session samples in the candidate whose nearest rounded state has absolute value at least 80 um
selection_rule.output: one create-only JSON with parent and selected half-open bounds, chunk starts, both ranking statistics, exact input hashes and scope

acceptance: each selected interval contains exactly 300 complete C4 chunks and is contained in its parent
all candidate starts are evaluated under the frozen lexicographic rule
synthetic positive and tie-break fixtures pass
no arm, injection, sorter, saved-output outcome, RF or holdout is read
stop_conditions: input hash, clock, parent bounds or chunk grid mismatch
nonuniform or nonmonotone field time knots
multiple winners remain after the earlier-start tie break
any request to inspect an arm or injection outcome during selection

scope.can_establish: the deterministic field-only P4 subwindow bounds
scope.cannot_establish: reader equivalence, donor validity, arm readiness, scientific benefit or runtime

completion_condition: source/tests frozen after this contract, tests pass, one immutable field-only result packet is published
